_note: External damage amplifiers, values at 100% ability strength (wiki, read 2026-11-01). subsumedValue = Helminth version. Stacking: Roar is a faction-type bonus (additive with Bane/Expel mods, double-dips on status ticks, multiplicative with everything else); Eclipse multiplies almost all other damage buffs; Nourish works like an extra Viral mod. Tenacious Bond applies to your weapons only; Fired Up to companion weapons only.

buffs.name: Roar
buffs.note: Faction-type bonus vs every enemy: adds to Bane/Expel mods, counts twice on status ticks. Rhino 50%, subsumed 30%.

buffs.name: Eclipse (Solar)
buffs.note: Multiplicative with almost all other damage buffs. Mirage 200% at max rank, subsumed 30%.

buffs.name: Nourish
buffs.note: Works like an extra Viral mod. Grendel 75%, subsumed 45%.

buffs.name: Vex Armor (Fury, max)
buffs.note: Additive with Serration-type base damage mods. Verify value.

buffs.name: Xata's Whisper
buffs.note: Adds Void damage as its own element. Verify value.

buffs.name: Arcane Avenger
buffs.note: Additive with crit chance mods; assumes full uptime.

buffs.name: Tenacious Bond (+1.2 crit multiplier)
buffs.note: Adds a flat +1.2 to your weapons' FINAL critical multiplier (e.g. 4.0x becomes 5.2x), while the companion's crit chance is at least 50% (check it on the companion weapon). Not the companion's own weapon.

buffs.name: Fired Up (max stacks)
buffs.note: Sentinel weapons only: +5% Heat per hit up to +100% (20 hits), resets after 5s without hits.

buffs.name: Arcane Strike
buffs.note: Melee only: 15% chance on hit for +60% attack speed for 18s, refreshed by new procs (kept up in practice). Additive with Fury mods.
